title: pm(relay): a raw comment / comment_edit carrying a contract-review record is not judged for tier
body:
domain:skills#1 · os-project-manager · session_01FEkQ5pjSPT7ui2EUcunaVb

Filing gate: ① (a follow-up owed by work in flight: card #33603's verifier residual 7, deferred by PR #33711 and judged sound to defer by at-tier record 6890932729).

`post-stamped.mjs` and `label-write.mjs` refuse an at-tier record without `--tier-evidence` (since PR #33616). A raw relay `comment` or `comment_edit` op sent through `scripts/pm/fleet-write/dispatch.mjs` with the same body is not judged for tier at all, so a record that claims `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` can still reach a PR without its transcript being read.

## What lands

`scripts/pm/fleet-write/` (one reader: `verify-review-tier.mjs` and the record recognisers): a `comment` or `comment_edit` whose body is a contract-review record claiming a tier is refused unless the action carries the same tier evidence the stamped writers require, or is routed to them. Self-test rows both ways.

Card #33603's PR says `Fixes #33603`; this residual moves here. Same-file serial: after PR #33686 (#33540) merges.
